:::{#thm-loglik-iid}

#### Log-likelihood of an independent sample

For mutually independent data $\dsn{X}$:

$$\llik(\param) = \sumin \log{\p(\Rvar_\iobs = \rvar_\iobs \mid \param)}$$ {#eq-loglik-ind}

If the $\Rvar_\iobs$ also share a common distribution $\p(X = x \mid \param)$,
each term is $\log{\p(X = \rvar_\iobs \mid \param)}$.
:::

:::{.proof}

This is the solution to @exr-loglik-iid.

:::
